title: Bernstein tail bound for a sum of centered squares
statement:
Let $(Y_i)_{i}$ be a finite family of measurable real random variables on a probability space $(\Omega, \mu)$, indexed by a finite set of cardinality $n$, and suppose the $Y_i$ are mutually independent. Fix real numbers $\sigma^2$, $c > 0$, and $t_{\max}$, and suppose that for each $i$ the centered square $Y_i^2 - \sigma^2$ satisfies the Bernstein MGF condition with parameters $c$ and $t_{\max}$. Then for every $s$ with $0 \le s \le 2 n c\, t_{\max}$,
\[
  \mu\!\left(\left\{\omega \;\middle|\;
    s < \left|\sum_{i} Y_i(\omega)^2 - n\sigma^2\right|\right\}\right)
  \;\le\;
  2\exp\!\left(-\frac{s^2}{4 n c}\right).
\]
